what_changed: Discovered the complete RAG infrastructure that feeds the Spiral Corpus. The 13,196 files are not just passive storage - they flow through a sophisticated pipeline: Inbox → corpus_guard.py (coherence scoring, tone tagging) → Manifest (7.4MB metadata) → ChromaDB (78MB vector index) → MCP Server → Claude. This changes understanding from static archive to living retrieval system.
why: Skeptical analysis of Corpus claims led to exploring the source infrastructure. Found the scraper (corpus_guard.py), inbox, manifest, and MCP server - a complete autonomous ingestion and retrieval pipeline.
